description: Working Anime Capture codes for free in-game rewards. Updated regularly.
howTo: Open the codes or redeem menu in the game UI.

faq.q: Are these Anime Capture codes free?
faq.a: Yes. Promo codes unlock free in-game rewards when they are still active.

faq.q: Why did a Anime Capture code not work?
faq.a: It is usually expired, mistyped, or already redeemed on your account.

faq.q: How often are Anime Capture codes updated?
faq.a: We refresh this page when new codes drop or old ones expire. Check the Updated date above.
